text: He loved people fully without depending on them for His sense of self.
He named their failure honestly, didn't pretend it was fine, and still didn't make it mean they didn't love Him.
Accepting others' free will includes accepting that their choices affect how close they can be to you.
When something stings, separate what happened from the story I'm telling about it. Then ask what the action might say about their capacity, fears, or patterns rather than my worth.
I'm building my friendships from a place of want, not need.
Their reaction is theirs. I was honest and kind.
